title: Top-p keeps the nucleus
notes: The default: T = 1 and top-p with p = 0.9. Adding up from the top, mat, rug and box make 0.86, not quite enough, so tree joins them at 0.93. The other four words share the last 7% and drop out. Then u = 0.849 lands in box, the third word: top-p still lets a less likely word through.
